caveats: Replaces `roe_deer_generated`, withdrawn on 2026-08-06. That object had lost its far pair of legs into the green field it was photographed in. The id changed with it because this is a different animal: Commons files the source photograph under `White Dama dama` and the photographer's own description says Dama dama, so shipping it as a roe deer would have been a wrong label.
Slender through the body, which is a fallow deer's real proportion seen head-on and also the limit of what one broadside photograph can say.
